name: Kaima's focus
description: The jade-edged blade that is the crystallized focus of Chishiro and Kaima's bond; Tatsunari steals it and later it is reforged.

timeline.summary: Chishiro offers Kaima peace, and Kaima asks him to bond again; Chishiro raises the blade and a light is reborn.
